text: Four counts in earlier runs sat at the edge of what ten scrambled coppers showed. Here each is recounted as distinct sets of checks, so look-alike routes count once, against fifty fresh scrambled coppers.
Three fall back inside the range, with p of 0.24, 0.48 and 0.10. Quagmire IV at period 3 stays above all fifty: 12 against 0-11, p < 0.02, short of the 0.0125 four tests would need.
It is the same K4 data with a sharper chance level, not new data, and it was the most extreme of 12 cells looked at; corrected for that it is near 0.24. Experiment 0102 tests it directly.
